name: cfd-openfoam
description: Runs a laminar OpenFOAM case (ESI v2606) behind guards: case readable, laminar regime, checkMesh, convergence, mesh independence by GCI, then the pressure drop.
settles: reynolds number of a cfd case
lenses: the mesh that decides the number
a number for the wrong question
against something that is not this solver
origin: written for nopekit (GitHub issue #15) against ESI OpenFOAM v2606, run as an outside tool as pcb-kicad runs kicad-cli. Every log format, exit code and failure mode the gates rely on was measured on v2606 while the pack was written; the GCI arithmetic reproduces Celik et al. 2008's Table 1 and NASA NPARC's worked example.
